title: MissMAC-Bench: Building Solid Benchmark for Missing Modality Issue in Robust Multimodal Affective Computing
abstract: arXiv:2602.00811v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Current Multimodal Affective Computing (MAC) systems heavily rely on the completeness of multiple modalities to accurately understand human's affective state. However, in real-world scenarios, the availability of modality data is often dynamic and uncertain, leading to substantial performance fluctuations due to the distribution shifts and semantic deficiencies of the incomplete multimodal inputs. Known as the missing modality issue, this challenge poses a critical barrier to the robustness and practical deployment of MAC models. To systematically quantify this issue, we introduce \textbf{MissMAC-Bench}, a comprehensive benchmark designed to establish fair and unified evaluation standards from the perspective of cross-modal synergy. translated_title: MissMAC-Bench：为鲁棒多模态情感计算中的模态缺失问题构建可靠的基准
translated_abstract: 当前的多模态情感计算（MAC）系统严重依赖多个模态的完整性来准确理解人类的情感状态。然而，在现实场景中，模态数据的可用性往往是动态且不确定的，由于不完整多模态输入的分布偏移和语义缺失，会导致性能出现大幅波动。这一挑战被称为模态缺失问题，对MAC模型的鲁棒性和实际部署构成了关键障碍。为了系统地量化这一问题，我们提出了MissMAC-Bench，这是一个全面的基准，旨在从跨模态协同的角度建立公平统一的评估标准。我们提出了两项指导原则，包括训练期间不使用缺失先验，以及使用单一模型同时处理完整和不完整模态场景，从而确保更好的泛化能力。
tldr: 提出了MissMAC-Bench基准，从跨模态协同的角度为多模态情感计算中的模态缺失问题建立了公平统一的评估标准。
en_tdlr: MissMAC-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark that establishes fair and unified evaluation standards for the missing modality issue in robust multimodal affective computing from the perspective of cross-modal synergy.
